reason: On a replacement SD card reported blank before setup, a fresh Seedsow Demo boot installed this exact HEN. The maintainer reported a normal first Pokemon Z-A launch without R, then hbmenu and connected Moader runtime/FS on the second launch with R. Read-only SD FTP confirmed a 1908-byte META game policy afterward. The affected tester and other console setups have not retested this candidate.
validation_scope: The same-boot installation receipt verified matched RO/HEN/bootstrap startup, HEN protocol 7/result 0, game arm waiting, connected Moader resident/FS, restored FS cache, retired endpoint and closed listener. The maintainer used a replacement SD card reported blank before setup, launched Pokemon Z-A without R for at least 20 seconds, fully closed it, then held R through a second launch and reported hbmenu and Moader runtime/FS connected. Read-only FTP found /kaihen/bin/game/main.npdm with a META header and 1908 bytes after the game launches. The first-launch policy file was not independently read before the first launch; the blank-card initial state is user-reported. The affected tester's failure cause and behavior on their console remain unverified.
